topic: The year the sun went dark for 18 months and millions starved
hook: The sun went dark for 18 months. Millions starved.
script: The sun went dark for 18 months. Millions starved. In 536 AD a mysterious fog covered Europe, Asia and parts of Africa. Temperatures dropped. Crops failed. Snow fell in summer. Historians now call it the worst year in human history. A volcanic eruption likely caused it. Civilizations collapsed. Famine spread across continents. Follow for history's darkest forgotten years.
